answer: Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. The fee is charged through an ember debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the raven totals, and the mirror anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. At 2 units per epoch, sustaining 309 aliases for 46 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the hostile operator. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
